verdict.rationale: Missive is a SaaS team inbox, but it documents its own headless programmatic surfaces. There is a public REST API at public.missiveapp.com/v1 covering conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels and analytics, with documented rate limits and 429 handling. There is also an official MCP server, and drafts can be created through the API or MCP without the UI. Webhooks are mentioned in the developer tools overview, but only in a one-line summary. Nothing in the pack describes CI or headless-runner usage. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-oriented tooling and documentation, an OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), detailed webhook documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
